targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-996 (diagnostic, claim-free, PASS, all six preconditions met) is a GENUINE ADVANCE on V3-EXQ-591h and its self-route label nonetheless OVERSTATES what it shows. WHAT IT DOES NOT ESTABLISH: (1) THE ORACLE IS NOT INDEPENDENT OF THE GATE'S SIGNAL. The oracle moved WINDOW (pre-ep_min mean h_pos) but not SIGNAL -- it is still h_pos -- and the oracle partition [T,T,T,F,F] is reproduced EXACTLY by a pre-window crossing count on the same vector [25,8,28,2,0]. The confirmed 591h autopsy already recorded this exact reproduction and its own learning #3 asked for an oracle 'computed from a signal the gate does not read'; that was not done. (2) THE DISCRIMINATIVE DELTA IS ONE SEED. The admitted sets are strictly nested (SPIKE {42,43,44,45}, CROSSING {42,43,44}); the crossing gate never admits a seed the spike gate refuses and advances LATER on every co-admitted seed (104->116, 114->138, 100->106). SPIKE agrees with the oracle 4/5, CROSSING 5/5, so 5/5 agreement rests on seed 45 alone, at ZERO precondition margin (P5 = 1 vs threshold 1) and a ONE-crossing decision (crossing arm 2 vs threshold 3; the spike arm reads exactly 3 on the same seed). So the ARC-046 mechanistic path the driver docstring and the queue entry foreground (harm_gradient -> update_residue -> ResidueField.accumulate -> ARC-046 hazard-avoidance term in E3 scoring) was NOT exercised; the queue entry's claim that the channel was 'verified firing live in the final script via a diagnostic tick counter' is not supported by the run's own manifest. EXQ-ISEF-005 stays blocked. Two recording-accuracy defects to note: metrics.max_post_ep_min_crossings_spike is computed from ARM_CROSSING's scheduler_crossing_count, not ARM_SPIKE (a mislabel inherited from 591h), and two precondition `control` strings still describe the superseded full-run oracle this run replaced.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: harm_gradient_enabled is structurally inert under CausalGridWorldV2 default parameters (proxy-field mode): hazard_approach pre-empts the transition_type == 'none' gate -- known-by-contract since 2026-05-16, first measured by V3-EXQ-587, re-measured by V3-EXQ-996
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: CORRECTED after the red-team pass (Fable, 2026-09-04). At DEFAULT V2 parameters (proximity_approach_threshold 0.15, hazard_field_decay 0.5, harm_gradient_outer_radius 3.0) the harm_gradient branch cannot fire: any tick within Euclid <= 3.0 of a hazard has proximity field >= 1/(1+2) = 0.333 > 0.15, so hazard_approach (or benefit_approach under the MECH-203 tie-break) claims the tick first and transition_type is never 'none' inside the gradient band (0/4000 random-policy ticks in the red-team probe; 0/10 cells in V3-EXQ-996). It is REACHABLE, not impossible: raising proximity_approach_threshold above 1/(1 + decay * ceil(r_out*sqrt(2))) (~0.33) re-opens it (threshold 0.9 -> 24/2000 ticks). This pre-emption is ALREADY PINNED by contract: tests/contracts/test_harm_gradient_gap1.py::test_c3_suppressed_by_proxy_approach (use_proxy_fields=True, landed 2026-05-16 with the feature) asserts the gradient stays zero when proxy approach fires -- so the inertness was designed in, not a regression, and repair option 'let harm_gradient fire under proxy mode' would BREAK a pinned contract and needs a design decision, not a bug fix. FIRST MEASURED by V3-EXQ-587 (ISEF-001, V2 mode, 2026-05-19: C1 0/5, ratios ~1.0) and read then as a 'null on geometry'; infant_substrate:GAP-10 was stamped done at queue time -- a plan reconcile is OWED (GAP-10 prose should say the channel is inert at default params). What this entry now asks for is NOT a build: (1) record on INF-ENV-001 that the shipped channel is inert at defaults, (2) require any consumer enabling harm_gradient_enabled to run with a raised approach threshold or proxy fields off AND to record a per-cell fire count, treating zero as a readiness failure, (3) reconcile GAP-10 and re-read 587's null accordingly. node_class: complicated (buildable) for the recording/readiness guard; the design question (should the gradient pre-empt approach?) is a decision, owed to the user, not a spike.
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.severity_note: DEGRADING, not corrupting. Nothing measured so far is invalidated: 996's DVs are sound (divergence real, sourced from transient_benefit); 576 validated the feature with use_proxy_fields=False, the mode where it is live; 587's null stands as measured but its GEOMETRY reading is owed a re-read (the channel was inert, so 587 measured nothing about geometry). What is degraded is ATTRIBUTION -- any future experiment crediting harm_gradient_enabled for a behavioural effect at default params is crediting a dead channel.

learning_extracted: A precondition computed on the SAME statistic the outcome routes on can be arithmetically pinned rather than informative. crossing_counts_reach_gate_minimum reads MAX over seeds of ARM_CROSSING's own scheduler_crossing_count, which stops incrementing at advance -- so an advancing seed reads EXACTLY the threshold and the precondition reduces to 'at least one seed advanced'. It also cannot distinguish 'the gate is starved' from 'the gate is maximally conservative and correctly rejected everything': both read below floor and both self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue.

Moving an oracle's WINDOW is not the same as moving its SIGNAL. The 591h autopsy asked for an oracle 'computed from a signal the gate does not read'; 996 moved the oracle from full-run to pre-ep_min h_pos, which makes the windows disjoint but leaves both read-outs as thresholds on one persistent per-seed property -- and the pre-window crossing count still reproduces the oracle partition exactly, on the identical vector the earlier autopsy named.

When one gate's admitted set is a strict SUBSET of the other's, 'agrees with the oracle on 5/5' can carry an effective n of 1. Report the DELTA over the control arm and the per-seed decision margin, not the total agreement count: here SPIKE 4/5 vs CROSSING 5/5 rests on one seed, decided by a one-crossing difference at zero precondition margin.

A channel-liveness counter added by a red-team pass is only as good as somebody reading it. n_harm_gradient_ticks was added specifically to confirm the channel engaged rather than merely being wired, then read 0 in all ten cells while the queue entry recorded the channel as 'verified firing live'. A liveness counter needs a REGISTERED FLOOR that self-routes on zero, exactly as the trajectory-divergence precondition does.

A feature validated in one env mode can be structurally inert in another, and the validating experiment can be the reason nobody noticed. V3-EXQ-576 validated harm_gradient with use_proxy_fields=False -- the only mode in which the branch is reachable -- so the pre-emption by hazard_approach in the CausalGridWorldV2 factory's proxy-field mode went unexercised for four months while the substrate_queue title advertised the feature as being 'in CausalGridWorldV2'.

The CausalGridWorldV2 factory (causal_grid_world.py:5373) always sets use_proxy_fields=True, so every V2 consumer is affected. Its validating experiment V3-EXQ-576 passed with use_proxy_fields=False EXPLICITLY (838/5895, 814/5823, 691/5987 gradient fires) -- the feature works, and this interaction was simply never exercised. Measured 2026-09-04: 0 harm_gradient ticks in all 10 cells of V3-EXQ-996 (>11,000 Phase-1 steps in ARM_SPIKE/42 alone); an independent random-policy probe under phase-1 env_kwargs gives transition_type counts {none: 61, hazard_approach: 502, resource: 16, agent_caused_hazard: 9, env_caused_hazard: 12} with harm_gradient 0/600 and harm_gradient_reward_this_tick nonzero on 0/600; and harm_gradient_enabled ALONE causes exactly ZERO behavioural divergence from phase-0 over 200 ticks on 2 seeds, while transient_benefit_enabled ALONE reproduces the full phase-1 divergence. Two candidate repairs, both `complicated (buildable)`: (a) make the gradient branch additive rather than 'none'-gated, so it composes with hazard_approach instead of being consumed by it -- note this changes reward magnitudes for any existing V2 consumer and must be flag-gated no-op-default; (b) if the pre-emption is intended, document harm_gradient as non-functional in proxy-field mode and have the constructor REFUSE or WARN on harm_gradient_enabled=True with use_proxy_fields=True, so a driver cannot silently believe it enabled a live channel. hypotheses.basis: V3-EXQ-591h's two arms were bit-identical on 5/5 seeds because the only wired channel had no consumer; the 591h autopsy prescribed env_kwargs plus a trajectory-divergence precondition.

resolution.basis: 135 diverging episodes across 4/5 seeds (591h: 0 across 5/5); independently confirmed by probe -- phase-0 vs phase-1 env under an identical 200-action stream differs on 166-185 of 200 ticks with identical initial layouts. Confirmed rather than eliminated: it is a positive readiness result, not the elimination of a rival.

hypotheses.label: The crossing-count gate DISCRIMINATES, rather than merely being more conservative
hypotheses.desc: The crossing-count gate's 5/5 oracle agreement reflects genuine competence discrimination, not a monotone shift that happens to drop one borderline seed on this draw.
hypotheses.basis: The admitted sets are strictly nested and the crossing gate advances later on every co-admitted seed, so the delta over the control is one seed at zero precondition margin -- consistent with both readings.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-996 does not discriminate the two readings: the oracle partition is reproduced exactly by a pre-window crossing count on the same signal, and the discriminative delta is one seed decided by one crossing. Left ALIVE rather than eliminated -- an uninformative run narrows nothing. Its adjudicating run is REFUSED as off the critical path, which is recorded here rather than papered over.
